S006: - Apply standard arithmetic precedence: parentheses first, multiplication and division next, then addition and subtraction.
S007: - Evaluate operators of equal precedence from left to right.

S012: - Print fractional results in decimal notation without unnecessary trailing zeros.
S013: - For division, this initial evaluation only requires cases whose exact results have terminating decimal representations.
S014: - Print only the result on standard output, followed by a newline.
S015: - Exit with status 0 after a successful calculation.
